query: Build the project list page: it fetches the user's projects and shows them as cards with a delete button on each.
expected_behavior: Renders loading, empty, error with retry, no permission, and success states, modeled as one union rather than several booleans
Uses a native button with an accessible name for delete, reachable and usable from the keyboard with visible focus
Rolls back an optimistic removal and tells the user if the delete request fails
Uses the project's design tokens and existing components, with no raw hex values
Checks the layout at 320 px wide with no horizontal scroll

query: Add a signup form with email and password, and show errors from the API.
expected_behavior: Reads reference/forms.md before building the form
Ties a label to each input and uses the email type and the right autocomplete tokens
Shows each error in text beside its field, maps server errors back to fields, and moves focus to the first invalid field on submit
Keeps every typed value when submission fails, and disables or deduplicates the submit while in flight
Validates on blur or submit rather than on every keystroke

query: Our product landing page scores poorly on Largest Contentful Paint and the layout jumps while it loads. Fix it.
expected_behavior: Measures LCP and CLS before and after on a throttled mobile profile, the same way each time
Gives the hero image high priority and never lazy-loads it, while lazy-loading images below the fold
Declares width and height or aspect ratio on every image and embed, and reserves space for late content
Reports the before and after numbers and keeps only changes that beat run-to-run variance
